FIDELIO-DKD.passage: RESULTS: During a median follow-up of 2.6 years, a primary outcome event occurred in 504 of 2833 patients (17.8%) in the finerenone group and 600 of 2841 patients (21.1%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.82; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.73 to 0.93; P = 0.001).

FIGARO-DKD.passage: The secondary composite outcome occurred in 350 patients (9.5%) in the finerenone group and in 395 (10.8%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.87; 95% CI, 0.76 to 1.01).

limitations: No full offline reproduce_review.py execution or fresh deployment attestation.

Original trial HRs were checked against sources, not re-estimated from participant-level survival data.
